rationale: Core machine-readable SI payment-statistics warehouse (cards, POS/ATM terminals, transactions) — the A4 backbone.
EN mirror of the same PxWeb tables; stable English dimension labels for cross-country schema mapping.
Top-level BS statistics index — best standalone entry point for detecting new/changed statistical domains.
Statistics domain sub-page already reached via the BS statistics hub and PxWeb series.
BS publications feed carrying the annual payment & settlement systems oversight report with infrastructure volumes.
Forward release calendar lets collection be scheduled instead of polled.
Reporting templates, code lists and legal basis define exactly what each payment series counts; updates flag series breaks.
Index of all BS reporting obligations; reveals datasets that exist beyond published aggregates.
One reporting obligation under the reporting hub already monitored.
Oversight section page within bsi.si payment-systems area; signals surface via publications and press feeds.
Authoritative register of banks, PSPs, EMIs and payment-system operators — the SI payments actor map.
Single dated issue of the bank fee comparison; valuable per-institution pricing evidence, discovered via the publications feed.
Press/objave feed is the fastest signal that new payment statistics landed, with official interpretation.
Cash-operations section supplies circulation and cash-cycle context for ATM demand.
Counterfeit statistics sub-page of the cash section already covered by its parent.
Infrastructure description sub-page; useful for operator names but not a recurring feed of its own.
Definitional glossary page under payment systems; static reference, no independent signal flow.
National Payments Council agendas/minutes give early industry signals ahead of statistics.
Digital-euro policy page; low-frequency and duplicated by BS press and ECB coverage.
Methodological notes sub-page of the statistics hub; reference material, thin on payments.
SDDS Plus landing page under the statistics hub; cross-check value only.
ECB Data Portal country view of SI; covered by monitoring the PSS/PTT datasets and the SDMX API.
ECB PSS dataset — harmonised, API-accessible master payments series with SI rows.
ECB PTT dataset gives the most granular EU-comparable SI ATM/POS terminal counts and throughput.
Card payment and card-fraud series by country; underpins SI benchmarking against euro-area peers.
SDMX web-service/bulk-download documentation — the engineering path to automate every ECB series here.
A single semi-annual ECB payments press release; useful context evidence, the series itself arrives via the datasets.
